welcome: 👋 Hello, {name}! Send me an Instagram, YouTube or TikTok link and I'll download the video or MP3 for you. 🎵 Type a song name (e.g. Shahzoda - Yetmadi) and I'll find it and send the MP3.
choose_lang: 🌐 Tilni tanlang / Выберите язык / Choose language:
help: ℹ️ How to use 1️⃣ Send a link: Instagram (post/reels), YouTube (video/Shorts), TikTok 2️⃣ Choose 🎬 Video or 🎵 MP3 3️⃣ Wait for the file 🔎 Music search: just type the song name. ⚙️ Commands: /start — start /lang — change language /help — help ⚠️ File size limit: {limit} MB.
unsupported_link:
❌ This link is not supported.

Supported platforms: Instagram, YouTube, TikTok.
not_media_link: 🤔 No video found at this link. Please send a link to a single video/post/reel.
choose_format: 📎 {platform} link detected. Which format do you want?
search_no_results: 😕 Nothing found. Try a different name.
search_too_short: ✍️ Please type a longer song name (at least 3 characters).
too_large:
😔 The file is too large ({size}). Telegram allows up to {limit} MB.

👇 You can choose MP3 or a lower quality instead:
too_long: ⏱ The video is too long (max {max} minutes). Please send a shorter one.
err_private: 🔒 This video is private and cannot be downloaded.
err_removed: 🗑 Video not found — it was removed or does not exist.
err_geo_blocked: 🌍 This video is not available in your region.
err_age_restricted: 🔞 This video is age-restricted and could not be downloaded.
err_login_required: 🔐 The platform refused to serve this video right now (login required or rate limit). Please try again later.
err_live: 📡 Live streams cannot be downloaded. Try again after the stream ends.
err_timeout: ⌛ The download took too long and was cancelled. Please try again.
err_unsupported: ❌ This link is not supported or no media was found.
err_unknown: ⚠️ Something went wrong. Please try again later.
rate_limited: 🚦 Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
link_expired: ⌛ This button has expired. Please send the link again.
forcesub_text: 📢 To use the bot, please join our channel, then press «✅ Check».
forcesub_ok: ✅ Thanks! You can send links now.
caption:
{title}

📥 @{bot}
compressed_note: ℹ️ Quality was reduced to fit the size limit.
admin_ytdlp_done:
✅ yt-dlp: {old} → {new}
